query:
SELECT 
  attendeeId,
  timeSlot,
  COUNT(*) as meeting_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(sponsorId ORDER BY sponsorId SEPARATOR ', ') as sponsor_ids,
  GROUP_CONCAT(id ORDER BY sponsorId SEPARATOR ', ') as meeting_ids
FROM meetings
GROUP BY attendeeId, timeSlot
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY attendeeId, timeSlot;
